<!--
  The lines of a cart as a table or as cards: product, variant, price, quantity, line total and a remove button.
  Axes: layout (table, cards), media (image, none), density, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { CartLine, CartLabels } from "./cart-list.types";

  export type CartListProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lines: CartLine[];
    labels: CartLabels;
    layout?: "table" | "cards";
    media?: "image" | "none";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
    onremove?: (id: string) => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Card from "../primitives/card/card.svelte";
  import CardContent from "../primitives/card/card-content.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import CartTable from "../components/cart-table.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import NumberField from "../components/number-field.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lines,
    labels,
    layout = "table",
    media = "image",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
    onremove,
  }: CartListProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((layout as string) === "table")}
    <CartTable
      field={tpl("{0}-qty", id)}
      lines={lines}
      labels={labels}
      media={media}
      density={density}
      onremove={(arg: string) => onremove?.(arg)}
    />
  {:else}
    <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" data-testid="cart-cards">
      {#each lines as line (line.id)}
        <Card variant="default" data-testid="item">
          <CardContent class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
            {#if ((media as string) === "image")}
              <MediaFrame alt={line.name} ratio="1/1" class="size-16 shrink-0" />
            {/if}
            <Stack gap="0" class="min-w-40 flex-1">
              <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                {line.name}
              </Text>
              <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {line.variant}
              </Text>
              <Text size="sm">
                {fmtMoney(line.price, line.currency)}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
            <NumberField
              value={(line.qty == null ? undefined : String(line.qty))}
              name={tpl("{0}-qty-{1}", id, line.id)}
              min="1"
              label={labels.qty}
              decrease={labels.decrease}
              increase={labels.increase}
            />
            <Text size="base" weight="bold">
              {fmtMoney((line.price * line.qty), line.currency)}
            </Text>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              layout="icon"
              aria-label={labels.remove}
              data-testid="remove"
              onclick={() => onremove?.(line.id)}
            >
              <LucideIcon name="x" size={16} />
            </Button>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      {/each}
    </Stack>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
